title: Part E shared experiment configuration - identical for Mode I (drawing) and Mode II (CAD data)
prepared_by: Claude Code (Anthropic, model claude-opus-5-5) as a proposing agent; every PENDING_HUMAN_REVIEW value must be decided by the team
isolation_rule: This file is sent VERBATIM (section 'ai_visible') to BOTH modes. It must not contain target geometry (dimensions, feature lists, coordinates of features). Geometry reaches the AI only through the mode-specific input: drawing images (Mode I) or the CAD manifest (Mode II). tools/apsd_part_e checks this before building a prompt.

value_classes.DRAWING_REQUIREMENT: stated on the part drawing (not used in this file: geometry is mode-specific input)
value_classes.CAD_EXTRACTED: read from the CAD model (only revision identifiers are used in this file)
value_classes.HUMAN_APPROVED: decided and signed by a named team member (Part B route sheet / tool sheet)
value_classes.SIMULATOR_SETTING: a property or default of LatheLab / MillLab (see simulator_dialect.json)

dependencies.02_Process_Plans: EMPTY on 2026-11-26 (only .gitkeep). Stock, tools, speeds/feeds, setups and work zeros below must be copied from the approved Part B route and tool sheets, so that the AI receives exactly the same process inputs as the human baseline.
dependencies.03_Lathe / 04_Mill: EMPTY on 2026-11-26. The brief (2.5) requires the human baselines BEFORE AI code is requested; the comparison is invalid if the AI prompts use different stock/tools than the baselines (EVALUATION.md E.3).
dependencies.01_Onshape_Drawings: Named version 'Ch2-Final' exists (link received 2026-11-28). onshape_link.txt and the drawing PDFs still have to be placed in 01_Onshape_Drawings by the Part A owner (or with the team's approval).

units.value: mm, degrees; G21 (metric) in every program
units.source: simulator_dialect.json (G21 supported in both labs); CAD manifests in mm

simulator.value: Course simulator https://mohammadrezaconstructor.github.io/cnc-simulator/ - LatheLab for turning, MillLab for milling

safety_scope.value: Programs are SIMULATION-ONLY candidates. They will not be run on a physical machine before independent human verification.
safety_scope.source: brief 2.10 integrity policy; team to confirm

required_output.value: see prompt template section 'Required response format' (features JSON, operation plan JSON, toolpath assumptions, operation-labelled NC blocks, consolidated program per setup, uncertainty list)

cad_revision.source: Onshape named version 'Ch2-Final' (created 2026-11-28 by the team); 06 evidence 20261128T085834Z_hmac_lathe

machine_type.value: 2-axis CNC slant-bed lathe, turret behind the centre line (rear tool post), as modelled by LatheLab

controller_dialect.value: Fanuc-style lathe G-code as implemented by LatheLab: X = DIAMETER (X0 spindle centre line), Z axial; U/W incremental; G90 = OD/ID turning BOX CYCLE (not absolute mode), G91 unsupported; G94 facing cycle; G98/G99 feed per min/rev; G96 CSS with G50 S limit; T0101 tool/offset format; cycles G70-G76, G92; supported G/M lists in simulator_dialect.json
controller_dialect.source: simulator_dialect.json (static reading of the simulator source, 2026-11-26) - the team must still test each used command in LatheLab (brief 2.5 'Lathe programming checks')

stock.source: Part B route sheet (02_Process_Plans) - outer diameter, length, any pre-bore, face allowance, grip length

material.source: not in CAD; Part B decision (LatheLab offers steel/stainless/aluminium/brass/castiron/plastic)

work_origin.value: Z0 on the finished front face of the current setup, negative Z towards the chuck; X0 on the spindle centre line, X as diameter
work_origin.source: LatheLab reference convention; must match the human baseline's setup drawing (Part C, C1)

setups.source: Part B (Q2.5): which end is chucked in setup 1 and setup 2, grip length, re-chucking reference

tools.source: Part B tool sheet; LatheLab default tool table (simulator_dialect.json lathelab.default_tool_table) is available but NOT approved

cutting_data.source: Part B (Vc, f, ap per tool, with the brief's equations 2.1-2.5)

safety_clearances.source: Part C setup log (safe approach point, tool-change position, retract)

simulator_setup.value: LatheLab: Stock dialog = Part B stock; Tools & offsets = Part B tools; Program check + Operations + Inspection; Check part only with a correctly configured target

cad_revision.source: Onshape named version 'Ch2-Final' (created 2026-11-28 by the team); 06 evidence 20261128T085839Z_hmac_milling

machine_type.value: 3-axis vertical machining centre with a vise, as modelled by MillLab

controller_dialect.value: Fanuc-style mill G-code as implemented by MillLab: G17/G18/G19, G90/G91 absolute/incremental, G94/G95, G54-G59, G43 Hnn tool length compensation (or AUTO TOOL COMP), G41/G42 Dnn cutter compensation only in G17, canned cycles G73/G74/G76/G81-G86/G89 + G80, M06 tool change; supported G/M lists in simulator_dialect.json
controller_dialect.source: simulator_dialect.json (static reading, 2026-11-26) - each used command still to be tested in MillLab

stock.source: Part B route sheet: block X x Y x Z, top allowance, height above vise jaws (MillLab stock is a rectangular block only)

material.source: not in CAD; Part B decision

work_origin.value: G54 at the front-left top corner of the block, Z0 on the finished top (MillLab default)
work_origin.source: MillLab default; must match the human baseline (Part D, D1) for setup 1 AND state the datum of every later setup (D4)

setups.source: Part B (Q2.2/Q2.5): number of setups, how the part is flipped/re-clamped, datum per setup

tools.source: Part B tool sheet; MillLab default tool table (simulator_dialect.json milllab.default_tool_table) is available but NOT approved

cutting_data.source: Part B (Vc, fz, z, ap, ae per tool, equations 2.1-2.6)

safety_clearances.source: Part D setup log (clearance plane, R-plane, tool-change height)

simulator_setup.value: MillLab: Workpiece dialog = Part B block + origin + Z reference; Tools & offsets = Part B tools (H/D registers or AUTO comp stated); one simulation run per setup

ai_system.value: Anthropic Claude via the claude.ai web chat (same interface as Chapter 1); model name recorded exactly as shown in the model selector at the time of each run
ai_system.source: team decision; alternative: Claude Code subagents (then record the model id they report)

isolation.value: One NEW conversation per attempt (4 initial attempts): no Project, no memory/history features, no attached files except the inputs listed in the run's input_manifest.json. Mode I runs never see manifests; Mode II runs never see drawings; no run sees the human baselines or the other mode's output.

attempt_order.value: After the human baselines are committed: Mode I lathe, Mode I milling, Mode II lathe, Mode II milling (order recorded; any change disclosed)

operation_split.value: One prompt per workpiece. If the reply is truncated or the geometry is too large, split into the SAME documented operations for both modes (brief 2.7.3)

acceptance_tolerance_simulation.value: +/-0.05 mm feature-level conformance in Check part / Inspection
acceptance_tolerance_simulation.source: LatheLab/MillLab mission default tol 0.05 mm (simulator source); the team decides the acceptance criterion
